# codigate_agent (Resource)

A Codigate agent: the outbound connector that runs next to your apps. The agent token is only known to Terraform when it creates or rotates the agent.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "codigate_agent" "home" {
  name = "home-lab"

  # Change this value to rotate the agent token in place.
  rotate_trigger = "2026-01"
}

output "agent_token" {
  value     = codigate_agent.home.token
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Agent name (at most 100 characters).

### Optional

- `rotate_trigger` (String) Change this value (for example a date) to rotate the agent token in place. The old token stops working immediately. After terraform import the first apply only records the configured value; it does not rotate.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Agent id.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Agent token (cga_...), set as CODIGATE_TOKEN on the agent. Only known after create or rotate; null after import.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import codigate_agent.home agt_0123456789abcdef
```
